newsitem.title: USA: Stocks tumble as long-term bond rates soar.
newsitem.headline: Stocks tumble as long-term bond rates soar.

text.p: Stocks tumbled Friday, hurt by weakness in the Treasury market and rising long-term interest rates that pointed to fresh investor worries about inflation.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 156.78 points, or 1.9 percent, to 8,031.22 after falling 71 points Thursday. In the broader market, declining issues swamped advancers by a 24-5 margin on active volume of about 567 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The 30-year Treasury fell 1-1/2 points, or $15 on a $1,000 bond, raising its yield, which moves in the opposite direction, to 6.64 percent from 6.53 percent Thursday.
